projects.name: trustlink
projects.title: TrustLink — Enterprise Identity & SSO Platform (OAuth 2.0 & OIDC)
projects.role: SLT Internship — Core Identity & Security Lead
projects.description: Full-stack OAuth 2.0 & OpenID Connect Single Sign-On identity provider with passwordless FIDO2/WebAuthn passkeys, PKCE, signed JWTs, and automated risk scoring.
projects.readmeExcerpt: Enterprise-grade Identity Provider (IdP) supporting Authorization Code Flow + PKCE, FIDO2/WebAuthn hardware & platform passkeys, and real-time suspicious login risk scoring with a React + Redux Toolkit admin console.
highlights: Developed a full-stack OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect identity provider with Authorization Code Flow + PKCE, signed JWTs and JWKS discovery, and refresh token rotation.
Integrated passwordless FIDO2/WebAuthn passkeys and Email/SMS OTP verification to enable single sign-on across enterprise telecom services.
Designed a sign-in activity and security logging pipeline with automated risk scoring and suspicious-login email alerts.
Built a React, Redux Toolkit and Tailwind CSS admin console with role-based access control, analytics dashboards and light/dark theming.
Containerized the platform with Docker and Nginx, and applied security hardening including rate limiting and vulnerability scanning.
projects.privateMessage: Private Enterprise Repository — Proprietary source code developed during SLT Internship (Access Restricted / NDA).

projects.name: trust-pass
projects.title: TrustPass — Flight Booking & Seat Reservation App (SLT TrustLink OIDC)
projects.description: Cross-platform Flutter application for Flight Ticket Booking, Airbus A380 Fuselage Seat Reservation, and QR Boarding Passes, integrated with Sign in with SLT (TrustLink OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect PKCE) and automated Cloud APK CI/CD.
projects.readmeExcerpt: Flight Ticket Booking, Airbus A380 Fuselage Seat Reservation & QR Boarding Pass App built with Flutter, integrated with Sign in with SLT (TrustLink OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect PKCE) and GitHub Actions Cloud APK CI/CD.
highlights: Engineered a cross-platform Flutter application for multi-leg flight ticket booking, dynamic Airbus A380 fuselage seat selection, and QR boarding passes.
Integrated Sign in with SLT powered by TrustLink OAuth 2.0 & OpenID Connect with RFC 7636 S256 PKCE authorization code flow.
Automated Cloud APK Build and Release pipelines using GitHub Actions CI/CD for continuous mobile delivery.
Implemented instant demo login, verified passenger claim synchronization, and offline-first QR pass rendering.

projects.name: zendata
projects.title: ZenData — Automated Data Quality & Semantic Hygiene Platform
projects.description: 4-Pillar Data Health Audit Engine & semantic hygiene pipeline that evaluates tabular datasets, reconciles financial formulas, and generates executive PDF/Excel audit scorecards.
projects.readmeExcerpt: Automated Data Quality & Semantic Hygiene Platform built with FastAPI, Pandas, NumPy, and Next.js. Evaluates Completeness, Uniqueness, Validity, and Statistical Consistency with 1.5x IQR outlier detection.
highlights: Engineered a 4-Pillar Data Health Audit Engine evaluating tabular datasets across Completeness, Uniqueness, Validity, and Statistical Consistency (using 1.5x IQR outlier detection) to generate real-time 0–100% quality scores.

Implemented Semantic Hygiene & Anti-Poisoning Rules in Pandas to purge sentinel placeholders (?, not given) and cluster categorical typos (Diary -> Dairy) without fabricating values for missing PII or transaction IDs.

Designed Mathematical Reconciliation Logic cross-validating financial formulas (Total = Qty x Price x (1 - Discount)) to reverse-engineer corrupted totals, outlier quantities, and inverted unit prices.
Automated Executive Reporting Pipelines leveraging ReportLab and OpenPyXL to generate landscape PDF quality audit scorecards and 3-sheet styled Excel workbooks with full transformation changelogs.

projects.name: loan-approval-prediction
projects.title: Loan Approval Prediction System
projects.description: End-to-end machine learning classification pipeline predicting loan approvals across 58,645 financial records with 99.97% accuracy and 1.0 AUC-ROC.
projects.readmeExcerpt: Financial machine learning classification pipeline trained on 58,645 records, benchmarking Logistic Regression, Gaussian Naive Bayes, and KNN with 5-fold GridSearchCV hyperparameter tuning.
highlights: Built an end-to-end ML classification pipeline in Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, Plotly) to predict loan approvals on a 58,645-record financial dataset.
Performed EDA and cleaned the data — missing value imputation, outlier capping via IQR, feature encoding, and scaling — to engineer a model-ready dataset.
Trained Logistic Regression, Gaussian Naive Bayes, and KNN classifiers with a stratified train-test split, achieving up to 99.97% accuracy and an AUC-ROC of 1.0.
Optimised model performance using GridSearchCV with 5-fold cross-validation across multiple hyperparameter combinations.

projects.name: suspicious-log-analyzer
projects.title: Suspicious Log Analyzer — Security Mini-Project
projects.description: Real-time Python security incident response tool that monitors server access logs, tracks IP behavior, and flags brute-force attacks for firewall blocking.
projects.readmeExcerpt: Lightweight cybersecurity log analysis engine designed to parse high-volume server access logs, track IP authentication patterns, and trigger automated brute-force alerts.
highlights: Developed a Python-based incident response tool to monitor server access logs and detect unauthorized access attempts.
Utilized data mining techniques and dictionary structures to track IP behavior and authentication statuses in real time.
Implemented a threat-detection threshold to automatically flag potential brute-force attacks for firewall blocking.

projects.name: spotit-lk
projects.title: Civic Engagement and Feedback Platform — SpotIT LK
projects.description: SDG 11-aligned civic engagement mobile platform enabling citizens to report public issues with compressed multimedia evidence synced in real time to government dashboards.
projects.readmeExcerpt: Mobile civic engagement platform built with Flutter, Dart, Firebase Firestore, and Firebase Cloud Storage, supporting UN SDG Goal 11 for transparent, community-driven urban governance.
highlights: Architected and implemented the multimedia storage infrastructure for a civic engagement mobile app, enabling citizens to upload and attach photo evidence to public issue reports.
Integrated Firebase Cloud Storage to securely host, manage, and retrieve user-generated media, ensuring scalable and efficient data delivery to government dashboards.
Developed seamless image capture and upload workflows within the Flutter frontend with low-bandwidth compression.
Supported SDG Goal 11 by building robust digital infrastructure for transparent, community-driven governance solutions.
